title: Audio Memo Replied Event
description: The agent's reply to the memo was rendered to speech and uploaded for playback on the Agent Pad. Last hop the pipeline can observe. Part of the voice memo journey: every stage fact and the agent invocation share correlationid = data.memo_id and ordering_key 'memo:<memo_id>'. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md.

memo_id.description: Journey id: uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, 's3://holocene-auto/' + s3_key). Also the correlationid of this event and of the agent invocation command, so one correlationid query returns the whole journey.

s3_key.description: Object key of the voice memo in the holocene-auto bucket: inbox/<agent>/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/<file>.

target_agent_id.description: Agent the memo is addressed to. Parsed from the S3 key path only, never inferred from audio.

reply_s3_key.description: Object key of the reply audio.

reply_text.description: The agent's reply text that was spoken.

spoken_chars.description: Characters actually sent to TTS (after cleaning and truncation).

command_id.description: command_id of the command this answers.

profile.description: Hermes profile that produced the reply.

session_id.description: Hermes session id the reply was read from.

agent_seconds.description: Seconds from dispatch until the gateway reported the turn complete.

tts_engine.description: TTS engine that served the request.

audio_bytes.description: Size of the uploaded reply audio.

journey_seconds.description: Seconds from memo received to reply uploaded.
